This appears to be a CBP ruling on remote-controlled tracked carriers with forestry mulching heads. The likely candidates are heading 8701 (tractors), 8429 (self-propelled bulldozers, etc.), 8433 or 8432 (agricultural machinery), 8436 (forestry machinery), and 8479.

The machines are not designed for hauling or pushing, which rules out 8701 tractors. Heading 8436 covers other agricultural, horticultural, forestry, poultry-keeping or bee-keeping machinery. Subheading 8436.80 covers other machinery, and 8436.80.00 is split into statistical suffixes: 8436.80.0100 for automatic or self-propelled? I recall 8436.80.0090 as "Other". Forestry machinery is covered by 8436.80.

Mulchers used in forestry and tracked carriers with a mulching head are commonly classified in 8436.80.0090. The 8436.80 subheading has two lines: 8436.80.0010 (Poultry-keeping machinery...?) and 8436.80.0090 (Other). I believe 8436.80.00 is divided into 8436.80.0010 for "Forestry machinery... ?" and 8436.80.0090 "Other". I'm not certain of the split, but I'll go with 8436.80.0090.

{"hts_code": "8436.80.0090", "reason": "Remote-controlled tracked carriers principally designed for forestry and vegetation control with forestry heads are classified as other forestry machinery in heading 8436, subheading 8436.80."}
